blocks.content: You can ask the user for input and assign it to a variable using the prompt() function. Here's an example:

1let firstName = prompt("Enter your name: ");
2console.log("Your name is " + firstName);

items: The program displays the text "Enter your name:".
It waits for the user to type something and press Enter.
The input is then assigned to the variable firstName.

blocks.content:
Enter your name: James
Your name is James

Enter your name: Emily
Your name is Emily
Next, let's see how you can take user input without displaying a prompt message.
